title_ar: فضيلة الشيخ يترأس المجلس العلمي للمركز
title_en: The Sheikh Chairs the Centre's Academic Council
body_ar:
ترأس فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو -حفظه الله- زوال اليوم الجمعة 5 رمضان 1437هـ، الموافق 10 يونيو 2016 م بمباني مركز تكوين العلماء اجتماع المجلس العملي للمركز في دورته العادية الثانية، وبحضور الدكتور محمد المختار ولد محمد المامي المدير العام للمركز وباقي أعضاء المجلس الموقر.

ويجتمع المجلس العلمي للمركز مرتين خلال العام ويتولى إعداد البرامج العلمية والتربوية، والإشراف على تحقيق و طباعة المقررات، وتحديد مدة الدراسة في المركز.
body_en:
His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew (may God preserve him) chaired, this Friday just after noon, 5 Ramadan 1437 AH, corresponding to 10 June 2016, at the buildings of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, the meeting of the Centre's Council in its second ordinary session, in the presence of Dr Muhammad al-Mukhtar Ould Muhammad al-Mami, the Centre's director general, and the remaining members of the esteemed council.

The Centre's Academic Council meets twice during the year. It is responsible for preparing the academic and educational programmes, for supervising the critical editing and printing of the set texts, and for fixing the length of study at the Centre.

flags.context: the first paragraph, against the title and the second paragraph, which both read المجلس العلمي
options: read as المجلس العلمي, the Academic Council
read as written, المجلس العملي, a 'Practical Council'
flags.note: SOURCE DEFECT, recorded not fixed (house rule 11): the body writes 'المجلس العملي' where the title and the very next sentence both write 'المجلس العلمي'. There is no separate 'practical council' at the Centre — record 913 distinguishes only the Academic Council from the Administrative Board — so this is a transposition. body_ar preserves it; body_en follows the reading the rest of the record supports.

translator_notes: 'زوال اليوم' is just after the sun's zenith, around the time of the Ẓuhr prayer; rendered 'just after noon'.
تحقيق of the set texts is critical editing from the manuscripts, not merely proofreading.
The CMS timestamp is a bulk-upload date, not the date of composition.
